name: Matt King
biography: Matt is a security geek responsible for ensuring platform and firmware trust at a cloud service provider, and dedicates an inordinate amount of time to updating firmware as a result. He has pen tested a broad range of systems as a product security validation lead at a prominent processor vendor, and has a history of rendering all manner of computing devices inoperable.
